lines.en: label toukaspring6:
scene noonsky
I’ve noticed lately that I’ve been running out of thoughts, which is odd because I didn’t really think that was possible.
lines.zh: 我最近发现自己快没想法了，这很奇怪，因为我本以为那不可能。

lines.en: I guess {i}that{/i} is a thought too, though. So here’s hoping I’m wrong and that it’s just the melancholy setting in again.
lines.zh: 不过，这大概也算一个「想法」。{i}所以{/i}但愿我错了，只是忧郁又犯了而已。

lines.en: Whatever the case, I don’t have any plans this afternoon. But none of the girls have school today, so I’m sure one of them will find me soon enough.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我下午没什么安排。但女孩们今天都不上学，所以我敢肯定，很快就会有哪个找上门来。

lines.en: {size=-2}And, if that’s not the case, I’m sure there’s a bridge nearby I can either throw myself off of or masturbate beneath because those are really the only two compulsions that govern my existence at this point.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}就算没有，我敢说附近也有座桥，我要么从上面跳下去，要么在桥底自慰——因为到这地步，支配我存在的冲动基本就这两种。{/size}

lines.en: Oh, I guess there’s a third one now too.
lines.zh: 哦，我猜现在又多了一种。

lines.en: I’m just not sure how I’d be able to move somewhere colder when none of us are ever getting out of here.
lines.zh: 只是我不太确定，既然我们谁都离不开这儿，我又怎么搬去一个更冷的地方。

lines.en: My phone goes off and, as if instinctive (because it basically is by now), I snatch it out of my pocket with amazing deftness that would make even mantis shrimp jealous.
lines.zh: 手机响了，我像出于本能（因为到现在基本就是本能）一样，以能让螳螂虾都嫉妒的利落劲儿把它从兜里掏出来。

lines.en: (That last line makes more sense if you know about mantis shrimp).
lines.zh: （最后那句，你要是了解螳螂虾，就说得通了。）

lines.en: : Hello?
: {i}Good afternoon, Sensei.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}下午好，Sensei。{/i}

lines.en: : Jessica?
lines.zh: : Jessica？

lines.en: : {i}Yes. It is me, Jessica.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}对。是我，Jessica。{/i}

lines.en: : That’s good. I was worried for a second that Touka might be calling me. I can’t stand that girl.
lines.zh: : 那就好。我刚才还担心是 Touka 打来的。我受不了那丫头。

lines.en: : {i}Oh? And why is that?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哦？为什么？{/i}

lines.en: : She just has so much money and hasn’t cured world hunger yet. She’s clearly a bad person.
lines.zh: : 她就是钱太多了，又没把世界饥荒治好。显然是个坏人。

lines.en: : {i}I’m sure she’s trying. And I’m sure you’re not much better in the grand scheme of things. So perhaps you should stop taking so much advantage of her?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我敢肯定她在努力。而且从大格局看，你也好不到哪儿去。所以也许你该少占她点便宜？{/i}

lines.en: : She’s actually one of the few I {i}haven’t{/i} taken advantage of yet, so I’m not sure where this is coming from.
lines.zh: : 她其实是我{i}还没{/i}占过便宜的少数人之一，所以我不知道你这话哪来的。

lines.en: : {i}Not sexually. But I’m sure you’ve taken advantage of things she’s given you. Large things. That many people would do many things to have.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不是性方面的。但我肯定你占过她给你的东西的便宜。很大的东西。大到许多人肯为此付出很多。{/i}

lines.en: : I’m confused because it sounds to me like you’re talking about her breasts and you just said it wasn’t sexual.
lines.zh: : 我糊涂了，因为听着像在说她的胸，可你又说不是性方面的。

lines.en: : {i}Hah...I’m talking about your apartment. Do you even use it? Like...at all?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哈……我说的是你的公寓。你到底有没有用过它？哪怕……一次？{/i}

lines.en: : Oh.
: Uhh...yeah. Sometimes.
lines.zh: : 呃……用过。有时候。

lines.en: : {i}When was the {i}last{/i} time?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}上次是什么时候？{/i}

lines.en: : I’m actually there right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在就在那儿。

lines.en: scene toukayasumovie1
: How peculiar. Because that’s where {i}I{/i} am right now and I don’t see you.
lines.zh: : 真怪。因为我现在就在那儿，而{i}我{/i}没看见你。

lines.en: : {i}What? Why are you in my apartment?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}什么？你为什么在我公寓里？{/i}

lines.en: : Probably because I’m a bad person. I needed somewhere to not solve world hunger.
lines.zh: : 大概因为我是个坏人吧。我需要一个不解决世界饥荒的地方。

lines.en: : {i}I think this probably goes against some sort of lease agreement.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我觉得这多半违反了某种租约条款。{/i}

lines.en: : Tell me, if you don’t intend to ever use this space for whatever {i}God-awful{/i} reasons I imagined you would have when I gifted it to you, would you mind if I {i}re-{/i}gifted it?
lines.zh: : 告诉我——既然你不打算把这地方用在我当初送你时想象的那些{i}天杀的{/i}用途上——你介意我把它{i}「转赠」{/i}出去吗？

lines.en: : {i}To who? Tsukasa already has one. She can’t have mine as well. I don’t care how many times she’s asked.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}给谁？Tsukasa 已经有一套了。她不能再要我这套。我才不管她问了多少次。{/i}

lines.en: : I was thinking more along the lines of a personal gift to myself. The rest of the rooms have already been rented out, you see.
lines.zh: : 我想的更多是送给我自己当私人礼物。你也知道，其余的房间都已经租出去了。

lines.en: : {i}Have they? Also, don’t you have like ten bedrooms? What do you need my apartment for?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是吗？再说，你不是有十来间卧室吗？要我这套公寓干嘛？{/i}

lines.en: : What do {i}you{/i} need your apartment for? Because it doesn’t seem like very much when I needed to have the place dusted just last month.
lines.zh: : 你要你这套公寓干嘛？因为我上个月刚让人给它除过尘——看{i}来{/i}你确实不怎么用它。

lines.en: : {i}Last month? Just how often have you been going there?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}上个月？你到底去过那儿多少次？{/i}

lines.en: : Enough to warrant having it dusted.
lines.zh: : 多到值得除一次尘。

lines.en: : {i}Probably just a coincidence. You see, I’m on my way to the apartment right now, actually.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}大概只是巧合。你看，我这会儿其实正往公寓去。{/i}

lines.en: : Oh? Do you remember how to get here or would you like me to send you the address?
lines.zh: : 哦？你是还记得怎么走，还是要我把地址发你？

lines.en: : {i}I remember how to get there because I’m there all the time.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我记得怎么走，因为我老在那儿。{/i}

lines.en: : Why are you keeping up this lie despite me having already claimed your bed?
lines.zh: : 我都已经占了你的床了，你为什么还要接着撒这个谎？

lines.en: : {i}You’re in my bed?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你在我的床上？{/i}

lines.en: : Chances are, I’ve slept in it more than you have.
lines.zh: : 搞不好，我睡它的次数比你还多。

lines.en: : {i}I bet I’ve had more sex in it.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我敢说我在这张床上做爱的次数比你多。{/i}

lines.en: scene toukayasumovie2
: Cute. Is that supposed to make me jealous?
lines.zh: : 可爱。这是想让我吃醋吗？

lines.en: : {i}Did it?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那你吃了吗？{/i}

lines.en: : A little.
lines.zh: : 有一点。

lines.en: : {i}Nice.{/i}
: Are you actually coming?
lines.zh: : 你到底来不来？

lines.en: : {i}I mean, I don’t really have anything else going on. Might as well.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我是说，我也没别的事。那就来吧。{/i}

lines.en: : Yasu’s here too. Do you mind?
lines.zh: : Yasu 也在这儿。你介意吗？

lines.en: : {i}Stop turning my bachelor pad into a daycare center. There had to be something in the lease agreement about this as well.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}别再把我的单身公寓变成托儿所了。租约里肯定也写了这条。{/i}

lines.en: : Why do you keep pretending you were involved in some sort of leasing process? Also, could you stop at the store and pick something up for me? Your refrigerator needs to be restocked.
lines.zh: : 你为什么老装作自己参与过什么「租赁流程」？另外，你能顺路去商店帮我买点东西吗？你的冰箱该补货了。

lines.en: : {i}For...me? Or for you?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}给……我补？还是给你补？{/i}

lines.en: : Can you pick something up or not? I need to know if I should make another call or not.
lines.zh: : 你到底能不能买？我得知道要不要再打一个电话。

lines.en: : {i}Yes, Touka. I can pick up condoms for you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}能，Touka。我可以帮你买避孕套。{/i}

lines.en: : I don’t believe those go in the refrigerator.
lines.zh: : 那玩意儿好像不用放冰箱吧。

lines.en: : {i}What? Of course they do. That’s how you prevent the spermicide from going bad.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}什么？当然要放。那样杀精剂才不会变质。{/i}

lines.en: scene toukayasumovie3
: Really? I had no idea. I suppose that makes sense, though.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？我都不知道。不过想想也有道理。

lines.en: : {i}Perfect sense. So what brand do you want? Your options are limited.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}太有道理了。那你要什么牌子的？你的选择有限。{/i}

lines.en: : To what, exactly?
lines.zh: : 具体有哪些？

lines.en: : {i}None because I refuse to wear them now that Makoto doesn’t make me anymore. See you soon.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}一个都没有，因为既然 Makoto 不再逼我戴了，我现在拒绝戴套。回头见。{/i}

lines.en: : Two bottles of barley tea, some chocolate for Yasu, and one of the premium ikura onigiri for me, please. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 请给我带两瓶大麦茶、给 Yasu 买点巧克力、再给我带一个高级鲑鱼籽饭团。谢谢。

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: : {i}Got it. I’ll be there in half an hour.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}收到。我半小时后到。{/i}

lines.en: : That seems quite long for someone who was already on the way.
lines.zh: : 对一个「已经在路上」的人来说，这似乎有点久。

lines.en: : {i}Yeah, well, I’m quite a long guy.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是啊，没办法，我这人挺「长」的。{/i}

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene toukayasumovie4
: ...Sensei?
lines.zh: : ……Sensei？

lines.en: : What an odd line to hang up on.
lines.zh: : 这句挂电话的台词可真怪。

lines.en: : What’d he say, Touka? Is he going to the store for us?
lines.zh: : 他说什么了，Touka？他会替我们去商店吗？

lines.en: : I’m not sure. He merely said he was a “long guy” and hung up the phone.
lines.zh: : 我不确定。他只说了他是个「长人」，然后就挂了。

lines.en: : Like his height? Or his sex organ? Because both are true, I think.
lines.zh: : 是指身高？还是指性器官？因为我觉得两样都是。

lines.en: : Please don’t say “sex organ,” Yasu. It’s unbecoming.
lines.zh: : 请别说「性器官」，Yasu。不成体统。

lines.en: : Oh, it be coming, alright.
lines.zh: : 哦，它「快要来了」（射了），没错。

lines.en: scene toukayasumovie5
: Did...did you just make a sex joke?
lines.zh: : 你……你刚才是不是讲了个黄段子？

lines.en: : The Emerald Guardian and Kendo Princess introduced me to comedy as part of the manga club! I’m still learning, though.
lines.zh: : 是「绿宝石守护者」和「剑道公主」在漫画部教我幽默的！不过我还在学。

lines.en: : That was actually quite good. Keep it up, Yasu. I’m very proud of you.
lines.zh: : 那个其实挺不错的。继续加油，Yasu。我为你骄傲。

lines.en: scene black
: Yay! Praise be! I have acquired humor!
lines.zh: : 耶！感谢赞美！我获得「幽默」了！

lines.en: : Just don’t acquire too much. I’m not fond of...{i}drastic{/i} change.
lines.zh: : 就是别「获得」太多。我不喜欢……{i}太大{/i}的改变。

lines.en: scene toukayasumovie6
: Okay. Two bottles of barley tea, some chocolate for Yasu, and a bunch of condoms for Touka’s secret gangbang party later. That was everything, right?
lines.zh: : 好了。两瓶大麦茶、给 Yasu 的巧克力、还有给 Touka 一会儿秘密群交派对用的一堆避孕套。就这些，对吧？

lines.en: : My onigiri?
lines.zh: : 我的饭团呢？

lines.en: : They were out. Just eat some of the condoms instead. You can ingest the flavored kind.
lines.zh: : 卖完了。你就吃点避孕套吧。有香味的那种是可以吃的。

lines.en: scene toukayasumovie7
: Of course. I mean, what other reason would there be to flavor them in the first place?
lines.zh: : 当然。我是说，不然给它们加香味是图什么？

lines.en: : Just make sure to refrigerate them afterward.
lines.zh: : 记得事后把它们放冰箱就行。

lines.en: : For the spermicide, yes. I remember.
lines.zh: : 为了杀精剂，对。我记得。

lines.en: : Hi, Sensei. I’m sorry I made you and Ayane very sad during Christmalloween.
lines.zh: : 你好，Sensei。对不起，我在「圣诞万圣节」那会儿让你和 Ayane 很难过了。

lines.en: : I have reflected on my actions since then and have reminded myself of why I should never talk to anyone about anything other than God. Praise be.
lines.zh: : 自那以后我反省了自己的行为，并提醒了自己：除了上帝，我绝不该跟任何人谈别的。感谢赞美。

lines.en: : You don’t need to apologize, Yasu. Everything makes me sad. Don’t take it personally.
lines.zh: : 你没必要道歉，Yasu。什么都能让我难过。别往心里去。

lines.en: scene toukayasumovie8
: I have to say, Sensei, I’m surprised you came.
lines.zh: : 我得说，Sensei，你居然来了，我挺意外。

lines.en: : Did you buy me a rug? That was not here last time.
lines.zh: : 你给我买了块地毯？上次来的时候还没有。

lines.en: : Another gift. You’re welcome.
lines.zh: : 又一份礼物。不客气。

lines.en: : Stop giving me things. Especially without informing me about it until way after the fact.
lines.zh: : 别再给我东西了。尤其别等过了好久才告诉我。

lines.en: : It’s for my own benefit as well if that makes you feel any better. You don’t mind if I continue to stay here, do you?
lines.zh: : 这对我自己也有好处，这样说你是不是好受点。你不介意我继续住这儿吧？

lines.en: : Uhh...why? You have the manor {i}and{/i} your dorm.
lines.zh: : 呃……为什么？你有大宅{i}和{/i}宿舍啊。

lines.en: : It’s just easier to get to the manor from here is all. And I like how...quaint it is. Plus, being here allows me to supervise what goes on in the apartment better than I can elsewhere.
lines.zh: : 只是从这儿去大宅更方便而已。而且我喜欢这儿……小巧别致的感觉。再说，待在这儿比待在别处，更能「监督」这套公寓里发生的事。

lines.en: : Touka also says that she likes how the bed smells like you.
lines.zh: : Touka 还说，她喜欢这张床上有你的味道。

lines.en: scene toukayasumovie9
: Wha...no I didn’t! I’ve never said that!
lines.zh: : 什……没有！我从没说过那种话！

lines.en: : Heheh...maybe it was just me then. I like it too. Sensei smells good.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……那大概是我说的吧。我也喜欢。Sensei 闻起来很香。

lines.en: : He just smells like...man!
lines.zh: : 他就是一股……男人的味道！

lines.en: : Mmm...{i}man smell.{/i}
lines.zh: : 嗯……{i}男人味{/i}。

lines.en: : Care to explain what’s going on here, Touka?
lines.zh: : 你能解释一下这是怎么回事吗，Touka？

lines.en: scene toukayasumovie10
: I’m honestly not sure if I can...
lines.zh: : 老实说，我不知道我能不能解释……

lines.en: scene toukayasumovie11
Seeing as I plan on staying here for a while and that I’m not actively having sex with either of these girls, our options when it comes to what to do are somewhat limited.
lines.zh: 既然我打算在这儿待一阵子、又没在跟这两个女孩中的任何一个做爱，那我们「该干嘛」的选择就有点有限。

lines.en: Refusing to ever lead, I let Touka take the reins as she’s far more experienced. And yes, that was a horse joke.
lines.zh: 我向来不肯带头，于是让更有经验的 Touka 掌缰。没错，那是个马的玩笑。

lines.en: Anyway, she takes it upon herself to put a movie on and, before I know it, the three of us are seated in front of the TV and watching-
lines.zh: 总之，她主动放了部电影，不知不觉间，我们仨已经坐在电视前看起了——

lines.en: : {i}Saw III?{/i}
: This is another scary movie, isn’t it? You know I’m not supposed to watch them, Touka. They make the voices come back, but they’re always {i}bad{/i} ones instead. I don’t like it.
lines.zh: : 这又是一部恐怖片，对吧？你知道我不该看这种的，Touka。它们会把「声音」引回来，而且回来的全是{i}坏{/i}的。我不喜欢。

lines.en: : You’ll be fine, Yasu. It’s all just special effects. In fact, I’d wager no real pigs were harmed at all. Just don’t quote me on that.
lines.zh: : 你不会有事的，Yasu。全是特效。其实，我敢说没有一头真猪受了伤。不过别拿我这句话当真。

lines.en: : I feel like I shouldn’t watch this without seeing the first two beforehand.
lines.zh: : 我觉得没看前两部之前，我不该看这部。

lines.en: scene toukayasumovie12
: You really haven’t seen this? But you’re so old.
lines.zh: : 你真没看过这部？可你年纪这么大。

lines.en: : Thank you, Touka. I appreciate that.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Touka。多谢提醒。

lines.en: : Who’s Touka? My name is Jessica.
lines.zh: : Touka 是谁？我叫 Jessica。

lines.en: : Then thank you, {i}Jessica.{/i} I appreciate you pointing out my age {i}after{/i} inviting me to hang out with you guys.
lines.zh: : 那谢谢你，{i}Jessica{/i}。多谢你邀我来跟你们玩{i}之后{/i}，还不忘点出我的年纪。

lines.en: scene toukayasumovie13
: Tell me when the movie is over so I can open my eyes again...
lines.zh: : 电影放完了叫我一声，好让我再睁开眼……

lines.en: : Age makes little difference to me, Sensei. Girls of my status are typically betrothed by this age.
lines.zh: : 年纪对我没什么影响，Sensei。我这种身份的女孩，到这个年纪通常都订婚了。

lines.en: : And most of us don’t put up a fight even if the husbands selected by our families are older than even you.
lines.zh: : 而且就算家里给挑的丈夫比你年纪还大，我们大多也不会反抗。

lines.en: : On that note, can you tell me how old your mom is? Because she definitely won’t.
lines.zh: : 说到这个，你能告诉我你母亲多大吗？因为她肯定不肯说。

lines.en: : Oh, of course. She’s-
lines.zh: : 哦，当然。她——

lines.en: scene toukayasumovie14
: Huh.
: How old {i}is{/i} she?
lines.zh: : 她{i}到底{/i}多大？

lines.en: : Is it over yet?...
lines.zh: : 还没放完吗？……

lines.en: The three of us proceed to sit there, watching the movie in silence as Touka presumably tries to figure out how old her mother is.
lines.zh: 于是，我们仨就那么坐着，沉默地看着电影——Touka 大概在拼命想她母亲到底多大。

lines.en: Well, two of us are watching the movie. One of us has their eyes closed. But, to be fair, she’s more accustomed than any of us to being blind, so this is probably fine.
lines.zh: 好吧，是两个人在看。有一个人闭着眼。不过公平地说，她比我们谁都更习惯「失明」，所以这样大概也行。

lines.en: scene toukayasumovie15
Oh. {i}This{/i} is happening too.
lines.zh: 哦。{i}这{/i}事也在发生。

lines.en: And quite randomly at that.
lines.zh: 而且来得挺突然。

lines.en: scene toukayasumovie16
I don’t know where Touka got the idea that she could just hold my hand like this, nor do I think she’d be able to comprehend that it’s a bigger step than even sex for me, but...it’s happening.
lines.zh: 我不知道 Touka 哪来的胆子就这么牵起我的手，我也不觉得她明白——对我来说，这一步比上床还大——但……它就是在发生。

lines.en: I’ve gotta admit, though. The non-chalantness of it all was rather smooth. So smooth that I don’t think even Yasu’s noticed.
lines.zh: 不过我得承认，这份不动声色还挺高明的。高明到我觉得连 Yasu 都没察觉。

lines.en: scene toukayasumovie17
Nevermind. She’s definitely noticed.
lines.zh: 当我没说。她绝对察觉了。

lines.en: Either that or she’s just staring at Touka’s boobs, which, fair.
lines.zh: 要么那样，要么她只是在盯着 Touka 的胸看——那也情有可原。

lines.en: : I can’t remember — do you enjoy horror movies, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 我不记得了——你喜欢恐怖片吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : They’re fine. I just feel like I’ve built up a bit of a tolerance to them given that I live in one.
lines.zh: : 还行吧。我只是觉得，既然我就活在一部恐怖片里，对它多少有了点免疫力。

lines.en: : So, if you were to choose a favorite subgenre or even just a {i}style,{/i} what would it be?
lines.zh: : 那，要让你挑一个最喜欢的子类型、哪怕只是一种{i}风格{/i}，你会挑什么？

lines.en: : I think you should go first since you clearly know more about this subject than me.
lines.zh: : 我觉得该你先说，因为你对这个话题明显比我懂。

lines.en: : Hmm...that’s a rather difficult question, I feel.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我觉得这问题挺难的。

lines.en: scene toukayasumovie18

: {size=-4}I’ve found I typically enjoy Asian horror the most. There’s something about the way Japanese and Korean films in particular provide subtle background details that I believe adds a great deal to the unsettling atmosphere of a scene as a whole.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-4}我发现我通常最喜欢亚洲恐怖片。尤其是日本和韩国电影那种不着痕迹的背景细节，我认为给整个场景的不安氛围加了很多分。{/size}

lines.en: : Even more so in scenes that seem otherwise normal and tonally light. Because, just like in reality, it’s what lies {i}beneath{/i} the surface that is normally the most disturbing.
lines.zh: : 在那些看似平常、基调轻松的场景里尤其如此。因为，就像现实一样，藏在{i}水面之下{/i}的，往往才是最令人不安的。

lines.en: : Do you have any examples of that?
lines.zh: : 你有什么例子吗？

lines.en: : Why, yes. There’s this man I know who presents himself as a regular teacher when, in all actuality, he’s an incorrigible monster feasting on the flesh of teenage girls as if it gives him life.
lines.zh: : 有啊。我认识一个男人，表面上装成一个普通老师，实际上却是个无可救药的怪物，把未成年少女的血肉当饭吃，仿佛那能给他续命。

lines.en: : Yet here you are holding his hand.
lines.zh: : 可你还牵着他的手呢。

lines.en: scene toukayasumovie19
: Why, yes. But I {i}like{/i} horror.
lines.zh: : 是啊。但我{i}喜欢{/i}恐怖片。

lines.en: scene toukayasumovie20
: And I could see myself falling for a monster under the right circumstances. Does that make me strange, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 而且在合适的情形下，我想象得出自己爱上一个怪物。这很奇怪吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : You were strange long before this reveal, Touka.
lines.zh: : 你早在这次「坦白」之前就很奇怪了，Touka。

lines.en: : I don’t like monsters. The last one I saw had a TV on his shoulder and a baby in his stomach.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢怪物。我上次见的那个，肩膀上扛着台电视，肚子里还揣着个婴儿。

lines.en: scene toukayasumovie21
: What? What is that creature from? I haven’t heard of this one at all.
lines.zh: : 什么？那是什么作品里的生物？我压根没听说过。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure she’s talking about Wilford Blackhole Hands.
lines.zh: : 我很确定她说的是 Wilford「黑洞手」。

lines.en: scene toukayasumovie22
: You know Wilford?! I don’t like him! He’s {i}scary!{/i} And always trying to slap me!
lines.zh: : 你认识 Wilford？！我不喜欢他！他好{i}吓人{/i}！还老想打我！

lines.en: : Why is it that both of you know of this {i}Wilford{/i} when I am the horror enthusiast here?
lines.zh: : 怎么你们俩都认识这个 {i}Wilford{/i}，明明我才是这儿的恐怖片爱好者？

lines.en: : You’re probably better off not knowing, Touka. You might fall for him.
lines.zh: : 你还是别认识他比较好，Touka。你会爱上他的。

lines.en: : Why do you know Wilford? Did you go to the shrine? You shouldn’t go there. It’s {i}bad.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你为什么认识 Wilford？你去过那个神社了？你不该去那儿的。那里很{i}邪门{/i}。

lines.en: : Why were {i}you{/i} there if it’s so bad?
lines.zh: : 既然那么邪门，{i}你{/i}当时干嘛去？

lines.en: scene toukayasumovie23
: I didn’t know what to do when all the noises stopped, so I had to resort to drastic measures. But I have learned my lesson...
lines.zh: : 当所有声音都消失的时候，我不知道该怎么办，只好采取了极端手段。但我已经吸取教训了……

lines.en: : I don’t want to see Wilford anymore...
lines.zh: : 我不想再见到 Wilford 了……

lines.en: : Well, now I just feel like I must.
lines.zh: : 好吧，这下我倒觉得我非见不可了。

lines.en: scene black
We wind up talking through the rest of the movie, which doesn’t seem to bother Touka as much as I thought it would. But I also imagine she’s seen it a million times before, so there’s that too.
lines.zh: 我们最后聊着天看完了剩下的电影——这好像没像我以为的那样让 Touka 不痛快。不过我想她以前大概看过无数遍了，所以也没差。

lines.en: The sun has gone down by the time the credits finish rolling. And seeing as I am now hungry and Touka is without her onigiri, the two of us get up to go find something to eat.
lines.zh: 片尾字幕放完时，太阳已经下山。而鉴于我饿了、Touka 又没吃到她的饭团，我们俩起身去找点吃的。

lines.en: scene toukayasumovie24
Yasu, on the other hand, decides against joining us. For reasons I’m sure she will very adequately explain in the moments to come.
lines.zh: 另一边，Yasu 决定不跟我们一起去。至于原因，我相信她接下来会「非常充分」地解释。

lines.en: : (Airplane noises)
lines.zh: : （飞机的声音）

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Ack..sorry...I think I swallowed another Yasu.
lines.zh: : 咳……抱歉……我好像又吞下了一个 Yasu。

lines.en: : Oh no. There are {i}more?{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦不。还有{i}更{/i}多个？

lines.en: : You sure you don’t want to come out with us? I can promise we won’t go to McDonald’s this time.
lines.zh: : 你真不想跟我们出去吗？我可以保证这次不去麦当劳。

lines.en: : As if I’d ever let you drag me into that establishment in the first place.
lines.zh: : 说得好像我一开始就会让你把我拖进那种地方似的。

lines.en: : I’m fine...I’m not very hungry. And I have the chocolate you bought me in case that changes.
lines.zh: : 我没事……我不太饿。而且万一饿了，还有你给我买的巧克力。

lines.en: : Also, the likelihood of Touka receiving your light goes {i}way{/i} up if I am not around to ruin things! And I want to save her most, so this is important to me!
lines.zh: : 再说，我不在场搞砸的话，Touka 得到你「光」的概率会{i}大很多{/i}！而我最想救的就是她，所以这对我很重要！

lines.en: scene toukayasumovie25
: What? Don’t just look at me like that after she blatantly alludes to us having sex.
lines.zh: : 干嘛？她刚才都明着暗示我们要做爱了，别用那种眼神看我。

lines.en: : I mean, I {i}did{/i} hold your hand. And I assumed that was a bigger step for you, so.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我{i}确实{/i}牵了你的手。而且我猜那对你来说是更大的一步，所以。

lines.en: : You bitch. You did comprehend it after all.
lines.zh: : 你这个小贱人。你果然心里门儿清。

lines.en: scene toukayasumovie26
: Aww, were you inner-monologuing about me? That’s so sweet. I’m never washing this hand again. Which is a big deal when I wash my hands at least twenty times a day.
lines.zh: : 哇，你刚才在心里念叨我了？真贴心。我这只手再也不洗了。考虑到我每天至少洗二十次手，这可是个大事。

lines.en: : That’s way too many times.
lines.zh: : 那也洗太多次了。

lines.en: : Maybe I just have some very unsightly habits I’ll never tell you about.
lines.zh: : 也许我有些极难看的怪癖，永远都不会告诉你。

lines.en: : Jesus, why are you so hot?
lines.zh: : 天，你怎么这么性感？

lines.en: : Sh...Should I close my eyes again?...
lines.zh: : 要……要不要再闭上眼睛？……

lines.en: scene black
: No, Yasu. That won’t be necessary. We’ll get out of your hair.
lines.zh: : 不用，Yasu。没必要。我们这就走，不打扰你。

lines.en: : I’m not sure when we’ll be back, though, so make sure to take your medicine when the alarm goes off. {i}Before{/i} your bath. I don’t want you almost drowning again.
lines.zh: : 不过我不确定我们什么时候回来，所以闹钟一响你就记得吃药。洗澡{i}前{/i}吃。我可不想你再差点淹死。

lines.en: : I’ll try my best, Touka. And thank you again for the chocolate, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我会尽力的，Touka。也再次谢谢你的巧克力，Sensei。

lines.en: : Please be gentle with Touka’s body since you are such a long guy.
lines.zh: : 既然你是个「长人」，请对 Touka 的身体温柔点。

lines.en: : I sure am, Yasu. I sure am.
lines.zh: : 我确实是，Yasu。我确实是。

lines.en: Having sufficiently navigated whatever just happened, Touka and I exit the apartment and head for the subway.
lines.zh: 把刚才那摊子事应付过去后，Touka 和我出了公寓，朝地铁站走去。
